findings.repro: cd <home>/OneDrive/Desktop/house_ai && python -W ignore <home>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-USER-OneDrive-Desktop-house-ai/e86e18f6-923d-4bcc-93e1-ba70c8993bc5/scratchpad/p1_red_leaks/id/probe_target_names_echo2.py  (and probe_target_names_echo3.py for unfamiliar things). Twins (same ids, constant salt), agent: approach <handle>, apply_label <handle> text='chlorine_bleach_bottle liquid_detergent fabric_softener'. Bleach twin -> "Labelled obj_217d6bab 'plastic jug of laundry liquid something something'"; detergent twin -> "'something plastic jug of laundry liquid something'"; softener -> "'something something plastic jug...'". 9/9 members of laundry_jug, spray_bottle and drink_carton, room AND geometric; the record stays 'unresolved' (no read). Unfamiliar things: 'electric_kettle something something' vs 'something hair_dryer something' vs 'something something remote_control' (3/3, both modes). Hidden string values leak the same way (word 'chlorine_bleach', the liquid, echoes verbatim only for the bleach twin: probe_target_names_echo.py). Same probe on K-LEAK's untouched pre-fix copy (scratchpad/p1_K-LEAK/prefix_tree, run via <home>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-USER-OneDrive-Desktop-house-ai/e86e18f6-923d-4bcc-93e1-ba70c8993bc5/scratchpad/p1_red_leaks/idpre/): every member word became the group label (no leak) -> introduced by the phase-1 I6 change. Mechanism: inbound keeps an id-like word that is in `names` (built from the TRUE record: type, liquid, product, every key and short string value) and turns every other id-like word into 'something'; the kept true type name is then rewritten to the group label by the outbound substitution. Channel demonstrated with apply_label (manipulation, any thing within reach); any action with an entity parameter plus an echoed text parameter carries it (label, tag_luggage, address_envelope, sow, set_timer, sound_alarm: same code path, not individually run). The upgraded auditor reports 0 leaks on this tree (its echo probe never names a target).
findings.fix: Build `names` only from what the robot perceives of the target (the keys/values of Realism.perceive_record / perceive_view of it at its current knowledge), never from the true record; in free text treat the type names of every member of the target's look-alike group (and of any unfamiliar thing) alike (all 'something' or all the shown label). Add a twin probe to tools/perception_audit.py echo: one unresolved member per twin, free text listing every member type name, through apply_label/label.
